title: Calling the Nordic model socialism is unsourced here
summary: The v1 article files Nordic countries under democratic socialism. That classification is disputed and was not documented.
body: The v1 socialism article says democratic socialism includes a strong welfare state and "Nordic model elements." Whether Sweden, Norway, and Denmark are socialist is a definitional dispute. This pass did not open a statistical office or a party platform. Leave the classification unsourced. Smith's book, Marx's texts, and the World Bank poverty page are the sourced economic cards.
